name: Apache Airflow
certifications: Astronomer Certification for Apache Airflow Fundamentals
Astronomer Certification DAG Authoring for Apache Airflow

beginner.summary: For data engineers and analysts new to orchestration. Covers Airflow concepts and architecture, local set-up, DAGs and tasks, operators, scheduling and data intervals, the TaskFlow API, XComs, connections and hooks, variables, sensors, dependencies and branching, retries and alerts, templating, the UI and CLI, dynamic task mapping, task groups, datasets, testing DAGs, simple ELT pipelines and good DAG design.
prerequisites: Writes Python functions and uses pip or uv
Comfortable with Docker and the command line
outcomes: Write, schedule and monitor DAGs with operators and the TaskFlow API
Connect to databases and APIs safely with connections and hooks
Handle retries, branching, sensors and dynamic tasks
Test DAGs and build a reliable ELT pipeline

days.topic: Apache Airflow Overview, Architecture and Local Setup
subtopics: Airflow compared with cron, Prefect, Dagster and cloud schedulers
Scheduler, webserver, workers, metadata database and triggerer
Airflow 2 and Airflow 3 differences in brief
Running Airflow with the Astro CLI
The UI: DAGs, grid, graph and logs
Project layout: dags, include and plugins
The course project: daily sales pipeline
days.lab_task: Start Airflow locally with the Astro CLI, run the example DAGs, read task logs in the UI and draw the architecture of your running installation.
days.deliverable: Running local environment and architecture sketch
checks: All tasks succeed in the grid view
Scheduler, webserver, database and executor roles correct

subtopics: DAG arguments: start_date, schedule and catchup
days.lab_task: Write a DAG with three tasks that download a CSV, clean it with Python and print a summary with Bash, with default arguments and DAG documentation.
checks: Tasks run in order and succeed
Parse error shown in the UI
DAG documentation visible in the UI

days.lab_task: Schedule the sales DAG daily, show how data intervals map to runs, run a backfill for the past week and fix a DAG that runs too often because of a wrong start date.
checks: One run per day of the week

days.lab_task: Rewrite the sales DAG with the TaskFlow API, pass results between tasks, run one task in a virtual environment with its own packages and mix in a classic operator.
checks: Task uses its own package version

days.lab_task: Pass a file path through XCom instead of the data, show the problem with a large XCom and configure an object storage XCom backend.
checks: Problem shown in the database or logs

subtopics: Connections in the UI, CLI and environment
Never putting passwords in DAG files
tools: HashiCorp Vault or a cloud secret store
days.lab_task: Create a PostgreSQL connection through an environment variable, load cleaned sales into it with a hook, call an API with HttpHook and move secrets to a secrets backend.
days.deliverable: DAG, connection configuration and secrets backend set-up

days.topic: Airflow Params, Settings and Run Configuration
days.lab_task: Move settings into variables read at run time, add DAG params with validation, trigger the DAG with a custom date range and show the cost of reading variables at parse time.
checks: Run uses the given date range
Run refused with a validation error

subtopics: Avoiding worker slots blocked by sensors
days.lab_task: Wait for a file before processing with a sensor in poke mode, switch to reschedule and deferrable modes and compare worker slot use.
days.deliverable: DAG versions and slot use comparison
checks: Processing starts after the file arrives
Fewer worker slots used when deferrable

days.lab_task: Branch the pipeline to skip loading on weekends, join after the branch with the right trigger rule, add a cleanup task that always runs and view the graph.
Add retries with backoff, a timeout and a Slack alert on failure, make the load idempotent so retries do not duplicate rows and alert when the DAG finishes late.

subtopics: Built-in macros: ds, data_interval_start and others
days.lab_task: Move SQL into templated files using the data interval, add a custom macro for a fiscal date, check rendered templates in the UI and fix a rendering error.

days.topic: Using the Airflow UI and CLI
subtopics: Browse menu: audit logs and task instances
CLI commands: dags test, tasks test and backfill
days.lab_task: Re-run a failed task and its downstream tasks, test a DAG and a single task from the CLI, trigger a run through the REST API and read the audit log.
checks: Clear a failed task with downstream

subtopics: Mapping over lists from upstream tasks
days.lab_task: Process one task per store file found at run time with dynamic mapping, limit concurrency, combine the results and re-run one failed mapped task.
checks: No more than three run at once

subtopics: Shared code in the include folder
days.lab_task: Organise a 40-task DAG into task groups per source, build a reusable group function for extract-and-load and move shared code into the include folder.
checks: Two sources use the same function
DAG parses with the include module

days.topic: Data-Aware Scheduling with Datasets and Assets
subtopics: Datasets in Airflow 2 and assets in Airflow 3
days.lab_task: Split the pipeline into a producer DAG that updates a sales dataset and two consumer DAGs that run when it changes, one waiting for two datasets.
checks: Update only one of two datasets

days.lab_task: Add tests that every DAG imports without errors and has owners and retries, unit tests for task functions and a CI workflow that runs them.

days.topic: Building an ELT Pipeline with Airflow and dbt
days.lab_task: Load raw sales into PostgreSQL, run dbt models and tests through Cosmos so each model is a task, and stop the pipeline when a quality check fails.
days.deliverable: Pipeline DAG, dbt project and run evidence
checks: dbt models appear as tasks and succeed

subtopics: Great Expectations or Soda with Airflow
days.lab_task: Add row count, null, uniqueness and freshness checks to the pipeline, fail on critical problems, warn on others and send the results to Slack.

subtopics: Avoiding heavy work in the scheduler
days.lab_task: Review three badly written DAGs against a checklist, fix heavy top-level code, non-idempotent tasks and missing owners, and measure parse time before and after.

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Daily Sales Data Pipeline
days.lab_task: Build a daily pipeline that waits for store files, loads them with dynamic tasks, runs dbt with quality checks, publishes a dataset for a reporting DAG, alerts on failure and is tested in CI, then demo a failure and recovery.
days.deliverable: Repository, DAGs, tests and demo recording
checks: Fail a load during the demo
Alert sent and re-run succeeds without duplicates
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one pipeline

intermediate.summary: For engineers who run Airflow in production. Covers executors, the Celery and Kubernetes executors, KubernetesPodOperator, scaling the scheduler, the metadata database, custom operators and hooks, providers, plugins, listeners, logging and monitoring, deployment, CI/CD, Airflow on AWS, GCP and Azure, orchestrating Spark and Databricks, event-driven DAGs, multi-tenancy, security and upgrading to Airflow 3.
prerequisites: Writes DAGs with operators, TaskFlow and connections
outcomes: Run and scale Airflow with the right executor
Extend Airflow with custom operators, providers and listeners
Deploy, monitor and secure Airflow on Kubernetes or managed services
Orchestrate cloud data platforms and upgrade to Airflow 3

days.topic: Executors and Choosing an Execution Model
subtopics: Sequential, Local, Celery and Kubernetes executors
days.lab_task: Run the same workload on the Local, Celery and Kubernetes executors, measure throughput and task start-up time and write a recommendation.
checks: Tasks per minute for each executor
Pod start-up cost shown for Kubernetes

days.lab_task: Run Airflow with Celery and Redis, route heavy tasks to a dedicated queue, scale workers under load and kill a worker to see tasks retried.
checks: Heavy tasks only on the dedicated worker

subtopics: Running any container as a task
days.lab_task: Deploy Airflow on Kubernetes with the KubernetesExecutor, give a heavy task more memory with a pod override and run a non-Python job in a container with KubernetesPodOperator.
days.deliverable: Helm values, DAGs and pod evidence
checks: Each task in its own pod
Heavy task pod has more memory
Container exits successfully and logs appear in Airflow

days.lab_task: Load 500 generated DAGs, measure scheduling delay, tune parsing and concurrency settings, add a second scheduler and measure again.
days.deliverable: Tuning log and metrics before and after
checks: Database tasks limited to the pool size

subtopics: Cleaning old records with airflow db clean
days.lab_task: Move the metadata database to PostgreSQL with PgBouncer, measure table growth, clean records older than 90 days and back up and restore the database.
days.deliverable: Database configuration, cleanup log and restore evidence
checks: Airflow works on the restored database

days.topic: Writing Custom Operators, Hooks and Sensors
subtopics: When to write a custom operator
days.lab_task: Write a hook and operator for an internal API, a deferrable sensor that waits for a job to finish and tests for each.

subtopics: Plugins for UI views and macros
Listeners for task and DAG events
days.lab_task: Package the custom operator as an internal provider, add a listener that records task durations to a database and turn on OpenLineage to capture lineage.
days.deliverable: Provider package, listener and lineage output

subtopics: Task log storage in object storage
days.lab_task: Send task logs to object storage, export metrics to Prometheus, build a Grafana dashboard for scheduler delay and failures and alert when the scheduler stops heartbeating.
days.deliverable: Logging and metrics configuration, dashboard and alerts

days.topic: Deploying Airflow: Images, Helm and GitOps
subtopics: DAG deployment: baked into images or git-sync
days.lab_task: Build a custom image with providers, deploy Airflow with the Helm chart through Argo CD, sync DAGs from Git and roll out a new image with no failed tasks.
days.deliverable: Dockerfile, Helm values and GitOps repository
checks: Running tasks finish and no failures

days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that tests DAGs, builds and scans the image, deploys to staging, runs a smoke DAG and promotes to production after approval.
Create an MWAA environment, deploy DAGs from S3, run Glue and Athena tasks with an IAM role, read secrets from Secrets Manager and view metrics in CloudWatch.
days.deliverable: Environment configuration, DAGs and monitoring screenshots

days.topic: Airflow on Google Cloud: Cloud Composer
days.lab_task: Create a Composer environment, orchestrate BigQuery loads and a Dataproc job with a service account and monitor runs in Cloud Monitoring.

days.topic: Orchestrating Azure Data Services with Airflow
subtopics: Azure Data Factory pipelines from Airflow
Key Vault as a secrets backend
tools: Apache Airflow on AKS or Astro
days.lab_task: Trigger an Azure Data Factory pipeline and wait for it, move files in ADLS, read secrets from Key Vault and run a Fabric or Synapse job from Airflow.
checks: Airflow waits and succeeds when it finishes

days.lab_task: Run a Databricks job and a Spark job on Kubernetes from Airflow with parameters, wait with deferrable operators and stop clusters after failures.
checks: No worker slot held while waiting

days.lab_task: Trigger a DAG from a file arrival event and from a queue message with run configuration, prevent duplicate runs for the same file and audit who triggered each run.
days.deliverable: Trigger set-up, DAG and audit records
checks: DAG triggered with the file name

days.topic: Multi-Team Airflow: Ownership, Pools and Permissions
days.lab_task: Set up roles so each team edits only its DAGs, give teams pools, enforce tags in CI and report task hours per team.
days.deliverable: Roles, pools, CI check and usage report

subtopics: airflow dags backfill and the UI backfill feature
days.lab_task: Backfill a year of data in monthly batches with a dedicated pool, reprocess one quarter after a logic fix without touching other months and notify downstream owners.
days.deliverable: Backfill plan, run history and notification
checks: All months processed within pool limits

subtopics: Network access to the UI and workers
days.lab_task: Turn on SSO with group-based roles, lock down the REST API, run tasks with least-privilege service accounts and review the audit log for configuration changes.

subtopics: Task SDK and the API server
days.lab_task: Run the Airflow 3 upgrade checks on the project, fix flagged code, upgrade a staging environment and run all DAGs to confirm they work.
days.deliverable: Check results, code fixes and staging run evidence
checks: Airflow 3 running with all DAGs parsed

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Production Airflow Platform on Kubernetes
days.lab_task: Deploy Airflow on Kubernetes with GitOps, CI/CD, SSO, a secrets backend, monitoring and team pools, run pipelines that orchestrate a cloud warehouse and Spark, then demo an upgrade and a recovery from a scheduler failure.
days.deliverable: Platform repository, pipelines, dashboards and demo recording
checks: Second scheduler continues and an alert fires
Deploy a DAG change through CI
Change live after tests and approval
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one platform

advanced.summary: For data platform engineers and architects. Covers Airflow internals, high availability, scaling to thousands of DAGs, DAG generation and factories, orchestration architecture, data contracts in pipelines, lineage and observability, reliability engineering, cost, multi-region, Airflow as a platform, migrating from other schedulers, orchestrating ML and LLM pipelines, alternatives such as Dagster and Prefect, compliance, contributing to Airflow, production troubleshooting and orchestration strategy.
prerequisites: Runs Airflow in production with CI/CD and monitoring
Knows Kubernetes and cloud data services
outcomes: Design and run Airflow at very large scale with high availability
Build DAG factories, contracts and lineage into pipelines
Lead orchestration strategy and incident response

days.topic: Airflow Internals: Scheduler Loop, DAG Processing and Task Lifecycle
days.lab_task: Trace a task from scheduled to success through database records and logs, create a zombie task and explain how Airflow detects and handles it.

days.topic: High Availability and Disaster Recovery for Airflow
days.lab_task: Remove single points of failure, run a DR drill restoring Airflow in another region from backups and recover runs that were in flight.
days.deliverable: HA design, DR plan and drill report
checks: Airflow running in the other region within the target

days.topic: Scaling to Thousands of DAGs and Tasks
days.lab_task: Load test with 5,000 DAGs and 100,000 daily tasks, find the bottleneck, fix it and decide when to split into several deployments.
days.deliverable: Load test results, fixes and capacity plan
checks: Split point and growth plan defined

days.lab_task: Build a factory that creates ingestion DAGs from YAML files, validate configurations with a schema in CI and onboard a new source with only a YAML file.
days.deliverable: Factory code, schema and generated DAGs

subtopics: Orchestration compared with transformation and ingestion tools
Orchestrating dbt, Spark, warehouses and SaaS tools
days.lab_task: Design orchestration for a company with 20 data teams and many tools, decide what Airflow orchestrates and what it does not, and defend the design.
days.deliverable: Architecture, decision records and review notes

days.topic: Data Contracts and Quality Gates in Pipelines
subtopics: Contracts with producers outside the data team
days.lab_task: Add data contracts for two upstream sources, check them before loading, quarantine bad batches, replay them after a fix and report breaches to producers.

days.topic: Lineage, Metadata and Observability with OpenLineage
days.lab_task: Capture lineage from Airflow, dbt and Spark into a catalogue, run impact analysis for a column change and trace an incident back to its source.
checks: Data flow across all three tools

subtopics: SLOs for data freshness and completeness
days.lab_task: Define freshness SLOs for five datasets, alert on burn rate, inject failures in sources and workers and prove recovery within the SLO.
days.deliverable: SLOs, alerts, chaos results and runbooks
checks: Recovery completed by a second engineer

days.lab_task: Measure cost per pipeline, cut idle capacity with deferrable operators and autoscaling, move workers to spot capacity and report monthly savings.
checks: Cost lower with the same results

subtopics: Why orchestrate across regions and clouds
days.lab_task: Orchestrate pipelines in two clouds with data that must stay in its region, choose one or several deployments and test failover of the orchestrator.
Build a template for new pipeline projects with CI, tests and standards, onboard a team through it and survey their experience.
days.deliverable: Template, onboarding record and survey results
checks: Create a project from the template
First DAG in production within a day

days.topic: Migrating to Airflow from Other Schedulers
subtopics: Migrating from cron, Control-M, Autosys and Oozie
days.lab_task: Migrate 30 jobs from a Control-M export to Airflow DAGs, map calendars and dependencies, run both in parallel and validate outputs before cutover.
days.deliverable: Inventory, generated DAGs, validation and cutover plan

days.topic: Orchestrating ML and LLM Pipelines with Airflow
subtopics: LLM pipelines: embedding, indexing and evaluation
days.lab_task: Orchestrate retraining with a GPU pod, register the model after evaluation with human approval, and run a nightly embedding and indexing pipeline with rate limits.

days.topic: Airflow Compared with Dagster, Prefect and Cloud Orchestrators
subtopics: Cloud orchestrators: Step Functions, Workflows and Data Factory
days.lab_task: Build the same small pipeline in Airflow, Dagster and Prefect, compare authoring, testing, observability and operations and recommend one for three scenarios.
checks: Tool chosen per scenario with reasons

days.topic: Compliance, Auditing and Change Control for Pipelines
subtopics: Audit trails for runs and changes
days.lab_task: Set up change approval for production DAGs, keep audit trails of runs and changes, remove sensitive data from logs and assemble an auditor evidence pack.
Set up Breeze, run a provider's tests, reproduce a reported issue and prepare a documentation fix or small pull request.
days.deliverable: Environment, test run and pull request draft
checks: Change with tests or docs ready

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Large Airflow Codebases
subtopics: Contract tests for operators and providers
Data tests compared with code tests
days.lab_task: Write a test strategy for 300 DAGs, add contract tests for the internal provider, spin up an ephemeral Airflow for integration tests in CI and cut suite time in half.
Diagnose five injected incidents (tasks stuck in queued, a database lock, a memory leak in a worker, a broken image and a slow scheduler), fix each and write a post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis notes, fixes and a post-incident review

days.lab_task: Assess orchestration maturity, write DAG standards and a review checklist and present a 12-month orchestration roadmap to a role-play leadership panel.

Design and build an orchestration platform for a case company: HA multi-team Airflow, DAG factories, contracts and quality gates, lineage, SLOs, cost reporting and a migration path from a legacy scheduler, then run a game day and present to an architecture board.
days.deliverable: Architecture records, platform code, game day report and board presentation
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one platform
